lines.zh: 长枪扛在肩上，我巡视营地。
lines.en: Pike on my shoulder, I walk the camp perimeter.

lines.zh: 皮甲有点松，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: My leather jerkin sits loose and rustles as I walk.
I circle the timber palisade.

lines.zh: 换岗的路上，我数着火把。
lines.en: On the way to my post I count the torches.
The ground is uneven; I keep my weight low.
I walk behind the knight's horse.
Pike point up, so I do not skewer anyone.

lines.zh: 我从箭塔下经过，抬头看了看。
lines.en: I pass beneath the archer tower and glance up.

lines.zh: 营地的火，等我回去换岗。
lines.en: The campfire waits for my relief shift.
The squad heads west; I take the rear.

lines.zh: 我扶正腰间的短刀，继续走。
lines.en: I straighten the short blade at my belt and walk on.

lines.zh: 营墙的影子在地上拉长。
lines.en: The palisade's shadow stretches across the dirt.
I step around that pile of muck.
A short jog to reach my post on time.

lines.zh: 我靠着栅栏，枪杆搁在脚边。
lines.en: I lean on the fence, pike resting by my feet.
The camp is quiet, only hooves sounding.
I rub my numb fingers together.
A dull watch is a good watch.

lines.zh: 我盯着火堆发呆，火在跳。
lines.en: I stare at the fire and it keeps jumping.

lines.zh: 护腕的带子松了，我重系。
lines.en: My bracer strap loosened; I retie it.
The smith's hammer carries from far off.
I stand the pike upright against the wall.
No password has come down yet. I wait.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，赶紧闭嘴。
lines.en: I yawn and quickly shut my mouth.
Whoever relieves me lets me eat.

lines.zh: 阳光照在甲片上，有点暖。
lines.en: Sunlight warms the plates on my chest.

lines.zh: 我的手一直搭在刀柄上。
lines.en: My hand never leaves the knife hilt.

lines.zh: 营门口的风吹得人清醒。
lines.en: The wind at the gate keeps me awake.
Halt. Who are you here for?
New here? I have not seen you before.

lines.zh: 把兜帽摘了，让我看看脸。
lines.en: Take the hood down so I can see your face.
Where is your pass?
This camp has no room for idlers.
What is that in your hand?
Three steps forward and keep your eyes still.
I know the knights. I do not know you.
Are you here with supplies?
Do not touch that banner.
Say it quickly; I am still on watch.
Do not step on that stone by your foot.
I ask again: where did you come from?
Your boots are far too clean.
Back beyond the line. Do not cross that ditch.
See the archers over there?
I only stayed upright by leaning on my spear.

lines.zh: 皮甲挡不住，我退了一步。
lines.en: Leather would not hold; I fall back a step.
I clamp a hand over the wound; it shakes.
The pain makes my vision swim.
I bite down and straighten up.
The pike nearly left my grip.
I heard something in me crack.
My bracer split in two.
My mail caught that one.
I drag my leg back to the wall.

lines.zh: 那锅里的味道飘过来了。
lines.en: Smells from that pot are drifting over.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸口袋，只有几枚铜币。
lines.en: I check my pocket: only a few coppers.

lines.zh: 面包的香气让枪都变沉了。
lines.en: Bread smells make my pike feel heavier.
I have looked at that pot twice now.
Whoever is handing out stew, I am at the back.
I swallow my spit back down.

lines.zh: 换岗前不许吃东西，我知道。
lines.en: No eating before relief. I know.

lines.zh: 那股甜味让我忘了看路。
lines.en: That sweetness made me forget the road.
My nose twitches. I cannot help it.
Just one bite; the officer will not see.
Hey, watch where you walk.
You bumped my pike.
Shift right; I cannot get past.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我还要挥枪。
lines.en: Not so close. I need room to swing.
If I give way, the whole line breaks.

lines.zh: 铁片碰铁片，吓得我一跳。
lines.en: Plate on plate gave me a start.
You stepped on my foot.
Queue up. Stop crowding forward.
I give you half a step. Go on.
Only one person fits through this gate.

lines.zh: 营里的洗衣妇，我总去帮她挑水。
lines.en: I always carry water for the camp laundress.
Her laugh is worth more than my pay.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一块肉留给她。
lines.en: I save the best cut of meat for her.

lines.zh: 夜里换岗后，我在墙下等她。
lines.en: After the night watch I wait for her by the wall.

lines.zh: 我们没说过以后，只说过今晚。
lines.en: We never spoke of later, only of tonight.
She pulls my armor straps tight.
I dare not promise her anything.
Her hands are covered in flour.

lines.zh: 两双鞋在门边并排放着。
lines.en: Two pairs of boots side by side by the door.
I walk her back to her tent flap.

lines.zh: 地上有根断箭，我捡起来。
lines.en: A snapped arrow on the ground; I pick it up.
Half a loaf here; it is still good.
I pick up a dropped belt buckle.
Someone lost a horseshoe.
I kick a stone off the path.
This length of rope will lash my pike.

lines.zh: 我捡了块磨刀用的石头。
lines.en: I found a stone good for sharpening.
An old copper coin in my pocket.
I refill the waterskin.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西交到营务处。
lines.en: Found goods go to the quartermaster.
Someone just came over the wall.

lines.zh: 我看见树影里有个轮廓。
lines.en: I see a shape inside the tree shadow.
That one is holding a blade.
He is heading for the granary.
I level my pike.
Target on the left of the gate.
He halts; so do I.
My eyes will not leave him.
Friend or foe, I treat him as foe.
I called out. He did not stop.

lines.zh: 他绕着火堆转，我跟着走。
lines.en: He circles the fire; I follow the circle.
My gaze stays on his knife.
He will not charge, so we take our time.
Pike point aimed at his chest.
I wait for him to cross that ditch.
He backs off; I press one step forward.
My palms are all sweat.

lines.zh: 那道门在我身后，不能丢。
lines.en: That gate is behind me and it will not fall.
His breathing is loud. I can hear it.
He raises his blade; I raise my pike.
The pike point goes straight for his shoulder.
I thrust and he slips aside.
The shaft sweeps his knee.
He closes in; I switch to the knife.
This thrust buries in his shield.
I step back and thrust again.

lines.zh: 刀锋在他臂上划开一道。
lines.en: My blade opens a line on his arm.
He lunges; I catch it on the shaft.
I kick his leg out from under him.
The butt of my pike cracks his wrist.

lines.zh: 我从营房的阴影里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the barracks shadow.

lines.zh: 新兵报到了，我站到队尾。
lines.en: New man reporting; I take the end of the line.
The pike has been issued to me.
I will hold this camp.
The camp gate opens in front of me.
I put on my helmet and buckle the strap.
I walk into the ranks through the morning mist.
The armor still fits badly, but I am standing.
Torches lit. I take my post.
First day. I grip the pike tight.

lines.zh: 袖子烧起来了，我拍打着。
lines.en: My sleeve caught fire; I beat at it.

lines.zh: 从墙上摔下，我摔得背疼。
lines.en: I fell off the wall and my back took it.
Moat water pours into my mouth.

lines.zh: 那声响把我掀进了土里。
lines.en: The blast threw me into the dirt.

lines.zh: 一支弩箭钉进我的大腿。
lines.en: A crossbow bolt is stuck in my thigh.
A cold force seeps into my chest.

lines.zh: 饿得我举枪的手在发颤。
lines.en: Hunger makes my pike hand tremble.

lines.zh: 雷打中枪尖，我整条手臂麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my spear tip and numbed my whole arm.

lines.zh: 黑里没有地，我抓不住枪。
lines.en: There's no ground in the dark, and I can't hold my spear.
